sources.author: Loki
patch_list: Lets the app run under a package name made by the Change package name patch: the app compares its own package name with the original at start-up and shuts itself down when they differ.
Removes the promo banner on the home screen and the cross-promotion and cloud-login cards on the save-success screen.
Turns on the app's paid features (unlimited scans, cloud upload, OCR, PDF passwords, compression, signatures, themes). Ads are removed by Hide ads (Doc Scanner).

Routes Google sign-in, Google Drive and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the push registration with Doc Scanner's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build, and…
Removes Doc Scanner's ads (Google AdMob and ironSource): banners, full-screen ads and rewarded ads. Works on its own, with or without premium.
